editorial.blurb: Korean BBQ and tofu soups that deliver when they're on—tteokbokki is a standout—though consistency issues and service hiccups have dimmed what was once a neighborhood favorite.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the tteokbokki, which reviewers consistently praise; skip the seafood soup (critics report it's underseasoned and overpriced) and go to their Glenview location if you can for more reliable execution.
